subtitle: Lesson 51 · Data Types, Strings, and Dates

code:
SELECT *,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY FirstName, LastName, EmailPromotion
    ORDER BY BusinessEntityID) AS RowNum
FROM Person.Person;
caption: Groups sharing the same values get numbered 1, 2, 3... RowNum > 1 = a duplicate.

eyebrow: Deleting everything past the first copy
code:
WITH NumberedRows AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY FirstName, LastName, EmailPromotion
      ORDER BY BusinessEntityID) AS RowNum
  FROM Person.Person
)
DELETE FROM NumberedRows
WHERE RowNum > 1;
caption: Keeps exactly ONE copy per group — the rest are removed.
